mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_sy_user WHERE user_id=#{userId})

SELECT p.proj_id AS "id",p.proj_nm AS "name",p.ctrt_type_cd AS "contractType", p.ctrt_bgn_dt AS "startDate",p.ctrt_end_dt AS "endDate",p.ctrt_amt AS "contractAmount", CASE WHEN p.proj_stat_cd='LOSE' THEN 'LOSE' WHEN p.ctrt_end_dt < #{today} THEN 'END' ELSE p.proj_stat_cd END AS "status",c.clnt_nm AS "customerName", (SELECT count(DISTINCT a.dev_id) FROM tb_pj_asgn a WHERE a.proj_id=p.proj_id AND a.asgn_stat_cd='ACT' AND a.input_bgn_dt <= #{today} AND a.input_end_dt >= #{today}) AS "personCount", CASE WHEN p.ctrt_type_cd='IN' THEN NULL ELSE part.part_nm END AS "partName",stage.dstrb_step_cd AS "selectedStep", COALESCE((SELECT sum(d.dstrb_amt) FROM tb_pj_tk_dstrb d WHERE d.proj_id=p.proj_id AND d.dstrb_step_cd=stage.dstrb_step_cd),0) AS "distributionTotal", (WITH distributed AS ( SELECT d.dev_id,d.dstrb_ym,sum(d.dstrb_amt) amount FROM tb_pj_tk_dstrb d WHERE d.proj_id=p.proj_id AND d.dstrb_step_cd=stage.dstrb_step_cd AND d.row_type_cd='DEV' GROUP BY d.dev_id,d.dstrb_ym ), actual AS ( SELECT m.dev_id,m.input_ym,sum(m.mon_mm) mm FROM tb_pj_asgn a JOIN tb_pj_asgn_mon m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.proj_id=a.proj_id AND m.dev_id=a.dev_id WHERE a.proj_id=p.proj_id AND a.asgn_stat_cd='ACT' GROUP BY m.dev_id,m.input_ym ) SELECT count(*) FROM distributed d FULL JOIN actual a ON a.dev_id=d.dev_id AND a.input_ym=d.dstrb_ym WHERE (d.amount > 0 AND COALESCE(a.mm,0)=0) OR (a.mm > 0 AND d.dev_id IS NULL)) AS "mismatchCount" FROM tb_pj_proj p LEFT JOIN tb_bs_clnt c ON c.clnt_id=p.cust_clnt_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT b.part_nm FROM tb_pj_proj_part h LEFT JOIN tb_bs_part b ON b.part_id=h.part_id WHERE h.proj_id=p.proj_id ORDER BY (h.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month}) DESC, CASE WHEN h.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} THEN h.aply_bgn_ym END DESC,h.aply_bgn_ym ASC LIMIT 1 ) part ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT d.dstrb_step_cd FROM tb_pj_tk_dstrb d WHERE d.proj_id=p.proj_id AND d.dstrb_step_cd IN ('PLAN','CTRT','EST') ORDER BY CASE d.dstrb_step_cd WHEN 'PLAN' THEN 1 WHEN 'CTRT' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END LIMIT 1 ) stage ON p.ctrt_type_cd='TK' WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_sy_user_scope s WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} AND s.scope_type_cd='PROJ' AND s.part_id IS NULL AND s.proj_id=p.proj_id) ORDER BY p.proj_id
